**Positioning summary (Dunford):**
- **Alternatives:** Jira/Linear (track, don't do work), hand-run agents (do work, no stages/review), cloud agents (code leaves machine), workflow builders (no git/gate), docs+chat (no provenance).
- **Unique attributes:** pure-function stages, git as DB, human gate default, per-stage cost/time, pipelines as data, BYO CLI, local-first, outdated propagation, self-dogfooding.
- **Value + proof:** trustable AI output (one small diff/stage), full provenance (tasks #108/#110/#122 branches), code never leaves machine (`server/bridge.js` loopback only), visible bottlenecks (metadata tracking).
- **Best-fit:** solo builder already running AI agents daily, git-native, burned by mega-diffs. Secondary: 2–10 person teams where agent = teammate. Target age ~22–45 (fills blank spec).
